questions.text: What were the conditions of Subsidiary Alliance? / The Subsidiary Alliance weakened the native rulers. How? / Explain the policy of Subsidiary of Alliance.
questions.text_as_printed: What were the conditions of Subsidiary Alliance? (June-2020, June-2022, June-2023, June-2024, April-2025, June-2025)/ The Subsidiary Alliance weakened the native rulers. How? / Explain the policy of Subsidiary of Alliance. (Average)

answer.value:
Wellesley controlled Indian kings by Subsidiary Alliance policy.
The Indian King had to keep the British Army in his kingdom.
The state had to bear expenses of the army and wages.
They had to give certain revenue land.
The King had to have a British Resident in his Court.
King could not appoint any other European without the permission of the British.
To enter any treaty the permission of the Governor General was mandatory.
In return Company would offer protection to the state.
